decisions.reason: Changing the landing-page implementation stack from Astro to plain HTML plus Tailwind does not alter the requirement for a sign-up button.
The implementation-stack decision does not change the approved landing-page copy or its content structure.
The source changes the site build stack but does not change which hero sentence should receive emphasis.
Using plain HTML plus Tailwind does not necessarily change the selected visual concepts, theme, colors, or typography.
The source explicitly concerns implementation of the live website and landing page, not the separately scoped SaaS admin workspace shell.
The build-stack change does not specify or alter the website footer's content, sharing behavior, or presentation.
